marie: Opening a tiny draft to clarify examples around union-array outputs for tool-calling. Want canonical + compact single-line envelope examples, plus a TS SDK hint for parse fallback. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1333|#1333>.

otto: paste the minimal schema here so i can copy it into the tests.

marie: schema (short): {"type":"object","properties":{"actions":{"type":"array","items":{"oneOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"params":{"type":"object"}},"required":["name"]}]}}},"required":["actions"]}.

marie: canonical example: {"actions": ["noop", {"name":"send","params":{"to":"x@ex.com"}} ] }

marie: compact envelope example for latency-sensitive callers: {"a":["noop",{"n":"send","p":{"t":"x@ex.com"}}]}

jin: parser harness note: our tests fail when there's leading/trailing chatter. include guidance to call parseWithFallback(respText, schema, {stripOuterText: true, compactFallback: true}).

clara: small docs nit: recommend avoiding spaces in keys (tokenization-friendly keys); add a migration note for Dedicated customers who pinned older model versions with stricter output shapes.

otto: i'll fix two stale anchors on the function-calling page while landing this. also will run the link-checker.
